content.text: {"name":"composition_flow_rates_spread_persist","hypothesis":"Groups whose flow rate V02 is high relative to flow rate V03, cross-sectionally standardized and smoothed over 3 months, have higher next-month returns, because this composition of flows signals stronger group momentum.
